---
title: "Runtime benchmark: R vs. ast2ast (VAPRO grid search)"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(microbenchmark)

cases <- list(
  DBA = list(
    file = "dba_host_const_real.txt",
    additionalParameters = c(host = 0.000151),
    lowerBounds = 1, upperBounds = 1e5
  ),
  IDA = list(
    file = "ida_real.txt",
    additionalParameters = c(host = 4.3e-6, dye = 6e-6, kHD = 1.7e7),
    lowerBounds = 1e-15, upperBounds = 1e10
  ),
  GDA = list(
    file = "gda_real.txt",
    additionalParameters = c(host = 50e-6, guest = 292e-6, kHD = 33000),
    lowerBounds = 5e3, upperBounds = 3e5
  )
)
nGrid <- 1000L
times <- 10L
```

```{r}
#| label: benchmark
bms <- lapply(names(cases), function(case) {
  cfg <- cases[[case]]
  case_expected <- list(
    DBA = "dba_host_const", IDA = "ida", GDA = "gda"
  )[[case]]
  path <- system.file("extdata", cfg$file, package = "tsf")
  df <- read.csv(path, sep = "\t", dec = ".", header = TRUE)

  spec <- tsf:::vapro_a2a_spec(case_expected)
  env <- tsf:::vapro_build_env(case_expected, df,
    cfg$additionalParameters, tsf:::get_error_calc_fct("Rel. Error")
  )
  add_params <- spec$build_add_params(df, cfg$additionalParameters)
  # translated outside the benchmark: compilation is a one-time cost per session
  loss_a2a <- ast2ast::translate(spec$loss_fct, types_f = spec$types_f)
  loss_r <- tsf:::vapro_loss_fct(case_expected)

  microbenchmark(
    R = tsf:::vapro_grid_search(loss_r, env, cfg$lowerBounds, cfg$upperBounds, nGrid),
    ast2ast = tsf:::vapro_grid_search_a2a(loss_a2a, add_params, cfg$lowerBounds, cfg$upperBounds, nGrid),
    times = times
  )
})
names(bms) <- names(cases)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-speedup
#| tbl-cap: "Median runtime of the VAPRO grid search (nGrid = 1000, 10 repetitions) and speedup of ast2ast over plain R."
speedup <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(bms), function(case) {
  t <- bms[[case]]
  med_r <- median(t$time[t$expr == "R"]) / 1e6
  med_a2a <- median(t$time[t$expr == "ast2ast"]) / 1e6
  data.frame(
    Model = case,
    `R [ms]` = med_r,
    `ast2ast [ms]` = med_a2a,
    Speedup = med_r / med_a2a,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(speedup, digits = c(0, 1, 1, 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: raw-results
for (case in names(bms)) {
  cat("\n", case, "\n")
  print(bms[[case]], unit = "ms")
}
```
